additional_findings: Official scalar results do not discriminate R1, R3, and R1+@ in this reference campaign.
R1+@ improves the QA-01 median for its 50 eligible bounded read-only cases but does not change the official p95.
All candidates miss the QA-12 target at 260 milliseconds.
decision.blocker: QA-07 lacks an evidence-anchored frozen minimum-mandatory-memory calibration.

evidence_blocker.missing_evidence_treatment: Emit an incomplete QA-v1 result envelope with no raw metric or score and block final DP-00 selection.
prohibited_shortcuts: infer a denominator from model parameter count
evidence_blocker.repository_audit_finding: No approved or frozen numeric minimum-mandatory-memory calibration exists. Numeric bytes found in evaluator self-tests are test vectors and are not calibration evidence.
evidence_blocker.workload_claim_limit: Evidence-anchored deterministic workload definition; it contains no measured device memory.
